raw_text: Fresh fighting between Myanmar's military and the Arakan Army in northern Rakhine State has triggered a new wave of Rohingya refugees attempting to cross into Bangladesh. The Bangladesh Border Guard fired warning shots near Teknaf as groups of approximately 500 people attempted to cross the border on Sunday morning. Refugee camps in Cox's Bazar, already sheltering over one million Rohingya from previous waves, are struggling to accommodate new arrivals. Indian intelligence agencies are monitoring potential secondary migration routes through Tripura and Mizoram.
clean_text: Tatmadaw-Arakan Army fighting triggers new Rohingya refugee wave to Bangladesh. BGB fired warning shots near Teknaf. India monitoring secondary routes via Tripura and Mizoram.
